subject: Trading
title: The Pound Flash Crash: 2016
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Pound Flash Crash: 2016.

hook.text: At 7:07 AM on October 7, 2016, the British pound dropped 6% against the dollar in two minutes. Then it bounced back.

buildup.text: It happened during low-liquidity Asian trading hours, when few human traders were active.

discovery.text: Algorithms reportedly reacted to negative Brexit headlines and triggered a cascade of automated selling.

twist.text: A currency that represents the fifth-largest economy crashed and recovered in less time than it takes to boil water.

climax.text: The pound flash crash showed that even major global currencies aren't immune to algorithmic volatility spikes.

punchline.text: Two minutes can rewrite the foreign exchange market.

quiz.question: When did the 2016 pound flash crash occur?
options: During a Bank of England announcement
